title: Property of affine finite-presentation descent
statement:
The algebra $B_{\lambda_B}$ is finitely presented over
$A_{\lambda_B}$, and the constructed map $\beta_B$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: By the construction in [def-nagata-affine-fp-descent], the algebra $B_{\lambda_B}$ is the quotient of the polynomial algebra $A_{\lambda_B}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ by the finite list of lifted relations $r_{j,\lambda_B}$. Hence this displayed quotient is a finite presentation over $A_{\lambda_B}$.

After tensoring with $A$ over $A_{\lambda_B}$, each coefficient of $r_{j,\lambda_B}$ maps to the corresponding coefficient of $r_j$, by the defining compatibility of the chosen lifts. Therefore the resulting quotient is $A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(r_1,\ldots,r_m)$, namely the chosen presentation of $B$. This identifies the source of $\beta_B$ with the presentation of $B$.

The map $\beta_B$ sends each polynomial generator $x_i$ to the generator with the same name in $B$. Under the identification in the preceding step it is the identity on the quotient presentation, so the map sending each generator back is a two-sided inverse. Thus $\beta_B$ is an isomorphism.
